idea-plugin.name: Yet Another Worktrees Panel
idea-plugin.description:
Manage your Git worktrees from a "Worktrees" tab in the Version Control tool window.
  • List every worktree of the current repositories and branches without one.
  • Open a worktree in a new IDE window; show a branch in the Git Log.
  • Remove / prune a worktree, optionally deleting its branch — with guard rails.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
0.10.1
  • Fix: deleting a clean worktree whose branch was not fully merged took two passes — the Force checkbox that would have produced git branch -D was greyed out because the worktree had nothing to discard. It now stays available whenever ticking it can still change the outcome, and its label names both effects.
0.10.0
  • Show each worktree's lock state with an open/closed padlock icon in the Branch column; a locked worktree is excluded from Cleanup and cannot be deleted (git refuses to remove it).
  • Merged status now also detects squash- and rebase-merged branches, not just fast-forward ancestors — so a squash-merged branch is correctly flagged as merged / cleanup-safe.
